commands.text:
if [ -d playwright-report ] || [ -d test-results ]; then
  echo "::notice::Playwright failed — download the playwright-e2e artifact (HTML report + traces)."
else
  echo "::warning::Playwright wrote no report/traces (install or config failed before the runner). Re-run locally with PWDEBUG=1; traces need harness retain-on-failure."
fi

url="${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}"
if [ -z "$url" ]; then
  echo "::error::deploy-pages emitted no page_url — check environment github-pages, permissions pages:write + id-token:write. Next: re-run after Pages is enabled."
  exit 1
fi
# F-961db918: landing 200 is not enough — the secondary CTA is /handbook/.
probe() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  echo "Probing $label $target"
  local max=5
  local status=""
  local attempt
  for attempt in $(seq 1 "$max"); do
    status=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 "$target" || true)
    if [ -z "$status" ] || [ "$status" = "000" ]; then
      status="curl-failed"
    fi
    echo "$label attempt $attempt/$max: HTTP $status"
    if [ "$status" = "200" ]; then
      echo "::notice::Pages $label verified ($target returned 200)"
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -lt "$max" ]; then
      wait_s=$((attempt * 5))
      echo "::warning::Pages $label probe attempt $attempt/$max got HTTP $status for $target — sleeping ${wait_s}s (CDN lag)"
      sleep "$wait_s"
    fi
  done
  echo "::error::Pages $label verification failed after $max attempts — last HTTP $status for $target. Next: wait for CDN and re-run the workflow, or open $target"
  return 1
}
probe "$url" "landing" || exit 1
handbook="${url%/}/handbook/"
probe "$handbook" "handbook" || exit 1

commands.step: Strip _authToken from npmrc so OIDC can exchange
commands.text:
# F-8cdb6b66: v7 no longer exports a dummy NODE_AUTH_TOKEN (do not
# write an empty NODE_AUTH_TOKEN= to GITHUB_ENV — that recreates
# "auth is configured" for some npm versions). Strip any leftover
# _authToken line from .npmrc so a pin drift back to v6 cannot
# short-circuit the OIDC exchange (ENEEDAUTH).
unset NODE_AUTH_TOKEN
for rc in "${NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG:-}" "$HOME/.npmrc" .npmrc; do
  if [ -n "$rc" ] && [ -f "$rc" ]; then
    sed -i '/_authToken/d' "$rc"
  fi
done

commands.step: Install npm 11.6.2 in sandbox for OIDC trusted-publishing auth
commands.text:
# Node 22 bundles npm 10.x, which cannot do OIDC trusted publishing,
# and an in-place `npm i -g npm@11.6.2` races its own arborist rebuild.
# F-8cdb6b66: pin 11.6.2 (11.5+ required) — never npm@latest.
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@11.6.2
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
SANDBOX_NPM="$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm"
GOT="$("$SANDBOX_NPM" --version)"
echo "sandbox npm ${GOT}"
if [ "$GOT" != "11.6.2" ]; then
  echo "::error::pinned npm@11.6.2 but sandbox reports ${GOT}"
  exit 1
fi

commands.step: Verify release tag matches package.json version
commands.text:
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "Tag: ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} -> ${TAG_VERSION} | Package: ${PKG_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Release tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match package.json version ${PKG_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -d playwright-report ] || [ -d test-results ]; then
  echo "::notice::Playwright failed — download the playwright-e2e-release artifact (HTML report + traces)."
else
  echo "::warning::Playwright wrote no report/traces (install or config failed before the runner). Re-run locally with PWDEBUG=1; traces need harness retain-on-failure."
fi

commands.step: Pack tarballs and attach to GitHub Release
commands.text:
mkdir -p dist-tarballs
for dir in packages/schema packages/export-ai-rpg packages/export-unreal packages/export-godot packages/renderer-2d packages/editor; do
  (cd "$dir" && npm pack --pack-destination "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist-tarballs")
done
ls -la dist-tarballs
gh release upload "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" dist-tarballs/*.tgz --clobber
